instruction.text: Read the end of the scene and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
(After some time, Mayor Magnolia walks to the chest and opens it to reveal a large amount of glittering, shiny jewels.)

Mayor Magnolia: This is all mine now. (laughs) Every jewel and every gold coin in this chest is (shouting the word) MINE! (pauses) I will tell everyone those stinking dragons stole the treasure and that I will have to raise the taxes. I am the mayor, I am powerful and great! The people will have no choice but to believe me. Yes, and all the while, I will be building myself a beautiful palace in Austria with pools and patios and balconies and … (trails off into thought) What a perfectly evil plan!

(The lights dim until the stage is fully dark, while Mayor Magnolia’s evil laughter becomes louder.)
